alignments.note: Anarthrous Greek noun with supplied definite determiner: rule 51's anarthrous clause makes *The* an ordinary rule 7 helper on the noun.
Rule 21: the case preposition *of* rides with the article and the unit heads on *the*.
Rule 17: a source noun rendered *of + noun* heads on the noun; rule 26 keeps the two names split.
Split from Ἰησοῦ under rule 26 rather than sharing a head.

Rule 97: SBLGNT.MRK.1.1.v001 is marked FALLBACK EXCLUDED BY EVIDENCE — the compatible readings r01 and r02 carry υἱοῦ θεοῦ while the projection carries the bare r00-base, so the English *the Son of God* answers to source words the projection does not have. Rule 37 is ruled out: the licensing tokens stand in no verse of the projection, not in a neighbouring one.

review_notes: The ASV's own textual note ("Some ancient authorities omit the Son of God") corroborates the rule 97 reading of t009–t012.
